changes: Added experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs — the §5/§6 powered-ablation RUN DRIVER (infra-(a) piece 4): enumerates the full pre-registered cell matrix (5 arms × tasks × {null-ablation + B1-B15} × k) honoring §3 applicability (B4/B5/B10 exclude A1; null + the other 12 apply to all arms) with seeded reproducible order; canonicalizes each raw run into the EXACT §7 record by delegating to adjudicate.mjs + checks.mjs (no re-implementation); stamps denominatorSets[] per the 4 pre-registered §5 contrasts; applies the §7 validity filter (infra-void => re-run + durable log; task-failure kept), durably logs N/A exclusions + void events to sidecars, exits non-zero on incomplete runs; surfaces the §1 A2prime budget log (null off-arm); strict integer CLI parsing. Plus run-driver-selfcheck.mjs (130 offline assertions) and run-selfchecks.mjs aggregator wired into npm test via test:experiments.
usage: node experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs --tasks <ids> --k 5 enumerates the matrix (writes the N/A exclusions sidecar; no engine ran). Supply --engine <module.mjs> exporting default async (cell,attempt)=>rawResult to run the campaign. Verify offline: node experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver-selfcheck.mjs (130 assertions) or npm run test:experiments.
limitations: Builds and self-tests the driver only; does NOT run the live multi-day powered campaign (separate task) — without --engine the CLI refuses to run live. The A2prime ±20% band COMPUTATION lives in run-ablation/spend-accounting (B-5bfe); the driver only surfaces the band result faithfully.
pitfalls: The engine adapter MUST signal infraVoid:true ONLY for harness/API outages (never for task-level failures) or survivorship bias inflates success rates. A2prime engine results MUST populate the budget log (null fails validateRecord). materialHash drifts on every metadata commit — refresh stale verificationEvidence before TEST/DONE.
